diagnosis.tooling: per-point diagnostics lane (--diagnose points.jsonl) over held-out 2025, split by an as-of walk-forward starter designation (team's previous game's leading passer)
findings: The published coverage failure is a MIXTURE artifact, not aleatoric dispersion: 468 of 969 evaluated points belong to players who were NOT the previous-game starter, and 88% of those actuals are zero. P(actual<p10)=27.6% while upper quantiles are nearly calibrated (p90: 84.0%) — the left tail fails because the population mixes designated starters with backups who never play.

CONDITIONING INCONSISTENCY: a player who appears with zero pass attempts is excluded (void), but a player ABSENT from the boxscore entirely is scored as 0 — 687 zero-actual points enter through the absent branch. Prop-market void rules void a DNP either way.

Conditional on the previous-game starter (n=501, one zero): the WHOLE predicted distribution sits low — P(actual<p10)=2.8%, P(actual<p50)=23.4%, median residual +44.6 yds. Implied effective attempt share ≈0.74 versus the train reality that a playing starter takes 0.9577 of team attempts (2023-24: 993/1108 starter-games, share mean 0.9577, median 1.0) — the decayed walk-forward share smears the starter across DNP history and committee churn.
The P246 'center error' reading (MAE ≈ interval half-width) was the aggregate shadow of these two structural facts, exactly the inference the charter warned against.

elements.eligibility: player_pass_yds is evaluated ONLY for the team's projected starter: the previous game's leading passer by attempts (walk-forward, as-of); when no prior game exists in-state (season opener), the highest decayed qbShare candidate.
elements.voidConsistency: For player_pass_yds only, a projected starter ABSENT from the boxscore is VOID (excluded), identical to the existing zero-attempt exclusion and to prop-market void rules (the anytime-TD family's established DNP=void conditioning). Other families' conditioning is untouched by this candidate.
elements.starterShare: The projected starter's effective qbShare is max(walkForwardShare, TRAIN_STARTER_SHARE) where TRAIN_STARTER_SHARE = 0.9577, the 2023-24 mean attempt share of playing last-game starters — a computed train constant, not a tuned parameter. Backup passers' shares are unchanged (they renormalize through the existing allocation).

candidate.publishedSemantics: If promoted, the board publishes pass yards ONLY for the projected starter, labeled conditional-on-playing (void if he does not play) — participation evidence (live injuries/actives) still vetoes at publication exactly as today.
candidate.whatIsNotAllowed: No selection on 2025; no change to rush/receptions/receiving conditioning or parameters; no interval widening; no post-hoc recalibration.

protocol.fit: 2023-24 REG+POST, identical to champion, plus the train constant above
protocol.test: held-out 2025 scored once on the NEW conditioned population (projected starters with >=1 attempt), --runs 1000. REUSED SEASON per p246-evidentiary-status-annex.json — and this candidate's diagnosis derives from 2025 residuals, so the 2025 evaluation is confirmatory development evidence at best; the 2026 forward record is the deciding evidence.
protocol.baselines: rolling4 and shareVol recomputed on the identical conditioned points (comparable conditioning, per charter).

frozenBars.beatsBaselines: MAE beats rolling4 AND shareVol on identical points

decisionRule: ALL bars pass -> promotion recomputed under the standard gates with the starter-conditioned family definition; publication flows only through the receipt-driven gates with the conditional label. ANY bar fails -> REJECTED; pass yards stays withheld with the new quantitative reasons recorded.
notes: Registered before implementation; commit order is the proof.
